name: Bolo SEA: Thai & Vietnamese
subtitle: Speak Tagalog, Malay & more
description:
Learn to speak the languages of Southeast Asia with Bolo: short lessons, friendly conversation practice and a journey that gives you a reason to come back.

Whether you want to reconnect with family, explore your heritage or feel more comfortable in everyday conversations, start with words you can say out loud.

SPEAK, DON'T JUST MEMORISE
Hear words and phrases, practise speaking and get coaching to help you improve. Native script and pronunciation guides support your learning where available.

CHAT WITH BOLO
Practise everyday conversations with your AI language companion. Try a greeting, ask a question or talk about your day at your own pace.

LEARN THROUGH YOUR JOURNEY
Explore lessons, stories and games. Build your vocabulary, revisit what you've learned and see your progress as you go.

LANGUAGES
Burmese, Cantonese, Indonesian, Khmer, Lao, Malay, Tagalog, Thai, Vietnamese, Mandarin.

START WITH A FREE ZONE
Zone 1 is free in every included language. Continue with an All-Access subscription, or use in-app currency to unlock later stops in order. Optional in-app purchases are available.

AI speaking and chat features require an internet connection and your consent to use the services described in the app. You can review your choice in Settings.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings. Prices and available plans are shown in the app before purchase.

Privacy Policy: https://bolo-sea.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://bolo-sea.app/terms
